rules: Exactly one selected Finisher and one selected Trademark per deck
Selected Finisher and Trademark normally three copies each
Supporting Moves prioritise the move types printed on the selected Finisher and Trademark
Maximum five copies of one card
Fixed opening five contains three Momentum and two immediately low-cost Moves
Full authentic card pool available for testing
Separate Superstar editions use exact edition-key recommendations and alternate Finisher/Trademark routes when authentic alternatives are available.
